channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Trump says US has ‘agreed’ to continue Iran talks but ceasefire ‘over’
item.description: Iran has not responded to Trump's latest claim, which comes as new attacks threaten the full resumption of war.

item.title: Israeli drones strike Lebanon despite US-brokered framework deal
item.description: The latest strikes reportedly injure two, as Amnesty urges probe into earlier Israeli attacks which killed 24 civilians.

item.title: US-Iran escalation threatens oil supply recovery, warns IEA
item.description: Sources suggest that the ceasefire can be revived amid a lull in fighting and backroom diplomacy.

item.title: US-Iran war: Will peace talks resume, and when?
item.description: While Trump said the MoU with Iran is 'over', US officials have reaffirmed Washington's commitment to continue talks.

item.title: Huge crowds in Mashhad as Iran's late supreme leader is buried
item.description: Ali Khamenei was buried at the Imam Reza shrine, Iran's holiest Shia Muslim site, ending six days of public mourning ceremonies.

item.title: Palestinians mourn Gaza World Cup screenings organiser killed in Israeli strike
item.description: Aid worker Mohammed al-Wahidi had become a prominent humanitarian figure during the Israel-Hamas war.

item.title: What's next for Iran after the funeral of their late supreme leader?
item.description: The BBC's chief international correspondent looks at how Iran's new leadership will respond to several issues affecting the country.
